Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
If Reverend Blackwood plays MotS and the only equipment in library is Ankara
Citadel, what happens?

Roger

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If Reverend Blackwood plays MotS and the only equipment in library is Ankara
>Citadel, what happens?
>

Well, since he does not fulfill the requirements of Ankara Citadel (he's
!Tremere), he ends up with no equipment. Just like if you Magic of the Smith
when there is no equipment in your deck.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Hmm I would have thought he'd illegally try to equip it and ending up
>burning the card to ash heap and paying the cost of 2 blood for the card or
>something.

No, with Magic of the Smith (or any card that searches through you library for
something), you aren't required to actually get the card. You may actually
choose to fail to find it. (So if you Magic of the Smith even when your deck is
filled with equipment, you may choose to not equip with any of it).

Halcyan 2

Your equip action failed ( becasue you could not meet the requirements ).
You do not pay the cost of a failed action so you do not pay for Ankara.

The MotS action succeeded - its cost is paid.
You can't go looking through your library until the action succeeds.

You don't pay for the Citadel because you do not equip the Citadel (because you do
not meet the requirements of doing so).
